notes: A separate translation, not converted from Simplified Chinese; i18n:check fails on Simplified or Japanese shinjitai forms and on mainland vocabulary (視頻, 服務器, 網絡, 默認, 登錄, 設置, 信息, 賬號).
The player is always 你; 妳 fails the check. Fixed game characters (Akane, Yoru) may be 她.
Han runs quoted from the English (the two Japanese statutory page titles) are exempt from the shinjitai check.
Generated names are joined with no space in the default order: 雷霆 + 峰 = 雷霆峰, 雙生 + 刃 = 雙生刃.
A half-width space separates Han from numbers, Latin words and number placeholders; none next to full-width punctuation or text placeholders.
Computer players' generated names (Kaito Mori) are stored text and stay in Latin letters, as in every language.
